_comment: Bucket policy for csd-benchmark-inventory-reports. Allows the S3 service principal to write daily Inventory reports for the two benchmark source buckets, and only those buckets. The aws:SourceAccount and aws:SourceArn conditions enforce the confused-deputy protection AWS recommends. The Webapper account retains full read access via standard IAM (no statement needed here for that). Replace BUCKET_NAME at apply time via bootstrap_aws.sh.
